title: Doofus SMP
description: Doofus SMP is a survival multi-player server with a community constantly growing!
body:
Doofus SMP is a survival multi-player server! Some of our server features are below!

- We have extremely active voice chats!
- There are multiple worlds with different stories and features!
- You can use /home, /spawn, /sit, /shop and many other useful commands!

Factions: There are many factions like towns, cities, empires or clans! If you want you could try to take over the world (It's happened before)

And we have a Discord server with over 700 members! https://discord.gg/626bR8MfkK
